evidence.title: Create a custom palette – Radix Colors

name: Custom palette
summary: Builds a custom Radix Colors scale from a couple of reference colors, previewed across backgrounds, borders, solid and text steps.
description: An interactive generator on the Radix Colors site: pick an accent and a gray, and it produces a full palette from those reference colors. The preview shows the scale as backgrounds, interactive component fills, borders and separators, solid colors and accessible text, with steps 10 to 12 called out. The generated CSS can be pasted into a project and used like the regular Radix Colors scales.
contains: accent and gray pickers generate a palette from a couple of reference colors
preview groups: backgrounds, interactive components, borders and separators, solid colors, accessible text
steps 10, 11 and 12 highlighted for solid and text use
generated CSS pasted into a project like the built-in Radix scales
